description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/godunov_norm_D1_periodic driven by problems/godunov_norm_1d_eikonal_mms.esm, loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4). Forced-steady eikonal u_t = -S*godunov(u) + S|g'| with exact solution g = sin(2 pi x); the discretization error is the first-order Godunov truncation S*(|g'| - godunov(g)) = O(dx). The manufactured |g'| = 2 pi |cos(2 pi x)| has slope-sign kinks, but the Rouy-Tourin/Osher-Sethian entropy fix keeps the scheme first-order in L2 AND Linf uniformly, so both norms fall as O(dx) (expected order 1).
